tools.name: search_implants
tools.description: List or search the dental implant database (manufacturer, line, connection, platforms, status). Free. Returns ids for get_implant.

tools.name: implant_complications_reference
tools.description: Definitions, key findings, ICD-10-CM codes and checks for dental implant complications (mucositis, peri-implantitis, early failure, screw loosening/fracture, implant fracture). Free.

tools.name: diagnose_periodontitis
tools.description: Periodontal diagnosis from a de-identified 6-point chart: 2017 AAP/EFP stage, extent, grade, ICD-10-CM suggestions, rationale and documentation checklist. Clinical decision support for licensed dental professionals. Send no patient identifiers. Costs $0.25 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: get_implant
tools.description: Full spec for one dental implant system: connection, platforms, diameters, lengths, abutment screw torque, multi-unit torque, driver, with a source URL for each value. Unknown values are null. Costs $0.05 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: identify_implant
tools.description: Rank likely dental implant systems from observed features (connection type, platform/body diameter, body shape, bone/tissue level), with reasons for each candidate. Costs $0.10 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: lookup_icd10
tools.description: ICD-10-CM lookup for periodontal and dental implant conditions by code, free text, or structured condition (e.g. periodontitis Stage III generalized -> K05.323). Public-domain code set; no CDT. Costs $0.05 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: assess_periodontal_risk
tools.description: Periodontal risk assessment (Lang & Tonetti PRA): six vectors banded low/moderate/high, patient risk with the rule applied, suggested maintenance interval, and tooth-level adverse prognostic factors. Costs $0.15 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: assess_peri_implant
tools.description: Peri-implant status (health / mucositis / peri-implantitis) from clinical findings using 2017 World Workshop case definitions, with severity grade, ICD-10-CM suggestion and each criterion shown. Costs $0.15 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: get_component_compatibility
tools.description: Component compatibility for an implant system: its own abutment screw / multi-unit torques and driver, manufacturer-declared cross-system compatibility with sources, and similar interfaces flagged unverified. Costs $0.10 USDC per call (x402, Base).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_icd10" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: code, q, condition, stage, extent, severity, molar_incisor_pattern, acute, non_plaque_induced, complete, kennedy_class, failure_type, diabetes_type, limit

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_implant · Private data: search_implants · Public sink: diagnose_periodontitis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_implant · Private data: search_implants · Public sink: diagnose_periodontitis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
